CONSULTING STATEMENT OF WORK

Between Drift Labs and Ember & Co.

Section 1. Work. Drift Labs will deliver the website redesign by June 30.

Section 2. Fees and Cap. Fees total $40,000. Neither party's liability exceeds the fees paid.

/s/ Noel White, Drift Labs, April 2.

/s/ Ember & Co., April 3.

expected.rationale: Electronic signature markers for both parties, liability capped at fees paid, no change-of-control language.
